LanguageData.CRO_LightweavingDecoy_Inspect: Illusory decoy made of woven light.
LanguageData.CRO_Highstorm_Tip_Storm: A highstorm rages across the land. The winds carry stones and debris from the east, scouring everything unsheltered.
LanguageData.CRO_Highstorm_Tip_Weeping: The Weeping has settled over the land. Constant light rain falls, but no highstorms will come until it passes.
LanguageData.CRO_Highstorm_Tip_Imminent: The stormwall draws near. Those caught in the open will not survive.
LanguageData.CRO_Highstorm_Tip_Countdown: The next highstorm will arrive in approximately {0}.\nHighstorms sweep from east to west, carrying debris with enough force to shatter bone. Seek shelter behind solid eastern walls.\nSeasonal intensity: {1}
LanguageData.CRO_Highstorm_Tip_AfterWeeping: The Weeping falls before the next highstorm. The skies will weep for weeks, and no storm will cross them until it ends.\nThe next highstorm will arrive in approximately {0}.\nSeasonal intensity: {1}
